name: AI Studio
tagline: hassancs91's calm-premium studio brand: ivory paper, indigo, teal, a dotted grid, fade-and-rise with no bounce.

motion.direction: hassancs91 AI-studio brand: Linear / Vercel polish. Ivory paper with a faint dotted grid and a soft radial glow, Space Grotesk 600–700 display with tight tracking, Inter body, JetBrains Mono for stats and code. Indigo `ter` is the accent, teal `goldd` the secondary, yellow `gold` only as a highlight sweep. Entrances fade + rise 24 px over ~14 frames, ease-out, no overshoot; exits fade + fall faster; emphasis is an indigo underline wipe or a scale pop ≤ 1.06; stagger 3–4 frames; radius 14–16, soft shadows. A `chapterCard` for every "step N"; overlays only in the top / bottom bands, never over the presenter. No hard shadows, no 3 px borders, no stickers, no engagement-bait outro; felt-not-heard sound.
